component.name: Beam Research Toolkit
component.summary: Interactive Geant4 explorer for particle-beam simulation

description.p: Beam Research Toolkit is a desktop application with a bundled Geant4 runtime. Configure a beam, run a simulation, inspect hits and dose, and export results without compiling Geant4 yourself.
Built for students learning particle physics and for researchers who want a managed Geant4 instance with visual analysis and common lab export formats.
A 14-day trial is included. Subscription is handled inside the application.
